reason: NodeBB supplemental fixtures stored the deployment prefix in database URLs. Existing getters added the same prefix again, so inputs became /forum/forum/assets/uploads/... and did not exercise the intended cleanup paths.
correction: Create fixture files with NodeBB File.saveFileToLocal and store the URL it returns. This follows the project's filename normalization and raw database URL convention. Record upload URLs and calls to the injected failing unlink for diagnostic visibility; these fields add no pass/fail condition.

Every registered check and pass/fail predicate
Execution environments, scoring program and blind taste rubric
result_policy: Preserve v1 evidence and scores. Save v2 executions and scores separately and use one evaluator version throughout each comparison. Reference implementations may fail explicit task requirements; they do not define the acceptance standard.
